metadata.note: Original starter/demo questions. Replace with your own reviewed bank for production.

questions.subject: mathAA
questions.prompt: Evaluate f(x) = 3x² -5x +5 at x = 6.
questions.hint: Substitute the given x-value into the polynomial.

questions.subject: mathAA
questions.prompt: The equation 5x + 5 = 35. Find x.
questions.hint: Rearrange ax+b=c: x=(c-b)/a.
questions.explanation: Isolate x by subtracting the constant term, then divide by the coefficient.

questions.subject: mathAA
questions.prompt: For f(x) = 4(x -4), find f(3).
questions.hint: Substitute the input into the function.

questions.subject: mathAA
questions.prompt: Given f(x) = 4x^4, find f′(4).
questions.hint: d/dx(axⁿ) = anxⁿ⁻¹.

questions.subject: mathAA
questions.prompt: Evaluate ∫₀^4 5x² dx.
questions.hint: ∫x²dx = x³/3, then apply the limits.

questions.subject: mathAA
questions.prompt: Find the scalar product of a = (-5, 5, 2) and b = (-2, -1, 1).
questions.hint: a·b = a₁b₁ + a₂b₂ + a₃b₃.

questions.subject: mathAA
questions.prompt: Two sides of a triangle are 4 and 4 with included angle 30°. Find the third side to 3 d.p.
questions.hint: Use the cosine rule: c²=a²+b²−2ab cos C.

questions.subject: mathAA
questions.hint: P(X=k)=C(n,k)pᵏ(1−p)ⁿ⁻ᵏ.

questions.subject: mathAA
questions.prompt: Which transformation maps y=f(x) to y=f(x−3)+2?
questions.hint: Horizontal changes inside the function act in the opposite direction.

questions.subject: mathAA
questions.prompt: What is sin(30°)?
questions.hint: Use the exact special-angle values.

questions.subject: mathAA
questions.prompt: A fair die is rolled twice. What is the probability that both results are even?
questions.hint: P(even)=3/6 for one roll; independent probabilities multiply.

questions.subject: mathAA
questions.prompt: If log₂(x)=7, find x.
questions.hint: Rewrite the logarithmic equation in exponential form.

questions.subject: mathAI
questions.prompt: €1300 is invested at 3% compound interest annually for 4 years. Find the final value to the nearest euro.
questions.hint: A=P(1+r)ⁿ.

questions.subject: mathAI
questions.prompt: A car worth €40000 depreciates by 8% per year for 2 years. Find its value to the nearest euro.
questions.hint: Repeated percentage decrease: V=P(1−r)ⁿ.

questions.subject: mathAI
questions.prompt: Find the mean of [6, 16, 15, 10, 12].
questions.hint: Mean = sum of values ÷ number of values.

questions.subject: mathAI
questions.prompt: For y = 5x +2, find y when x = -2.
questions.hint: Substitute x into the linear model.

questions.subject: mathAI
questions.prompt: From a point 11 m from a vertical wall, the angle of elevation to the top is 50°. Find the wall height to 3 d.p.
questions.hint: tan θ = opposite/adjacent.

questions.subject: mathAI
questions.prompt: Write 0.000472 in scientific notation.
questions.hint: Move the decimal point until one non-zero digit remains before it.

questions.subject: mathAI
questions.prompt: The rate of change is f′(x) = 3x + 3. Find f′(4).
questions.hint: Evaluate the derivative function at the given x-value.

questions.subject: mathAI
questions.prompt: Which measure is most resistant to a single extreme outlier?
questions.hint: Think about which statistic depends mainly on the middle position rather than magnitude.

questions.subject: mathAI
questions.prompt: A map scale is 1:50 000. A distance of 6 cm on the map represents how many kilometres in reality?

questions.subject: mathAI
questions.hint: Write 81 as a power of 3.

questions.subject: mathAI
questions.prompt: For the model y=120(0.85)^t, what percentage decrease occurs each time t increases by 1?
questions.hint: A multiplier of 0.85 leaves 85%, so the decrease is 15%.

questions.subject: mathAI
questions.prompt: If f(x)=5x², find f′(2).
questions.hint: Differentiate first, then substitute x=2.

questions.subject: physics
questions.prompt: A 8 kg object moves at 9 m s⁻¹. Find its kinetic energy in J.
questions.hint: Eₖ = ½mv².

questions.subject: physics
questions.prompt: An object has initial speed 0 m s⁻¹ and constant acceleration 6 m s⁻² for 3 s. Find its final speed.
questions.hint: v=u+at.

questions.subject: physics
questions.prompt: A wave has frequency 170 Hz and wavelength 2.5 m. Find its speed in m s⁻¹.
questions.hint: v=fλ.

questions.subject: physics
questions.prompt: A component has potential difference 6 V and current 1.5 A. Find its resistance in Ω.
questions.hint: R=V/I.

questions.subject: physics
questions.prompt: A charge of 4e-06 C is in a uniform electric field of 8e+04 N C⁻¹. Find the electric force in N.
questions.hint: F=qE.

questions.subject: physics
questions.prompt: 0.2 kg of water is heated by 16 K. Take c=4200 J kg⁻¹ K⁻¹. Find the energy transferred.
questions.hint: Q=mcΔT.

questions.subject: physics
questions.prompt: A sample has activity 10 kBq. What is its activity after 2 half-lives?

questions.subject: physics
questions.prompt: A device transfers 50 W for 64 s. How much energy is transferred in J?
questions.hint: E=Pt.

questions.subject: physics
questions.prompt: A photon has wavelength 500 nm. Using h=6.63×10⁻³⁴ J s and c=3.00×10⁸ m s⁻¹, find its energy in J to 3 s.f.
questions.hint: E=hc/λ. Convert nm to m.

questions.subject: physics
questions.prompt: A net force of 18 N acts on a 3 kg object initially at rest for 4 s. Find the final momentum in kg m s⁻¹.
questions.hint: Impulse FΔt equals change in momentum.

questions.subject: physics
questions.prompt: Which radiation has the greatest ionising ability in matter?
questions.hint: Consider charge, mass and how strongly each interacts with matter.

questions.subject: physics
questions.prompt: Which quantity is measured in N C⁻¹?
questions.hint: Force per unit charge defines this quantity.

questions.subject: chemistry
questions.prompt: How many grams are in 1.2 mol of a substance with molar mass 44 g mol⁻¹?
questions.hint: m=nM.

questions.subject: chemistry
questions.prompt: 0.5 mol of solute is dissolved to make 2 dm³ of solution. Find concentration in mol dm⁻³.
questions.hint: c=n/V.

questions.subject: chemistry
questions.prompt: A solution has pH 3. Find [H⁺] in mol dm⁻³. Use scientific notation.

questions.subject: chemistry
questions.prompt: Which species has a tetrahedral electron-domain geometry around the central atom?
questions.hint: Four electron domains around carbon give a tetrahedral arrangement.

questions.subject: chemistry
questions.prompt: How many neutrons are in ³⁷Cl⁻?
questions.hint: Neutrons = mass number − atomic number. Charge does not change the nucleus.

questions.subject: chemistry
questions.prompt: A reaction has ΔH = 178 kJ mol⁻¹. What is the enthalpy change for 1.5 mol?
questions.hint: Multiply molar enthalpy change by amount in moles.

questions.subject: chemistry
questions.prompt: For A ⇌ B, equilibrium concentrations are [A]=0.2 mol dm⁻³ and [B]=0.25 mol dm⁻³. Find Kc.
questions.hint: For A ⇌ B, Kc=[B]/[A].

questions.subject: chemistry
questions.prompt: A fixed amount of product forms in 22 s under condition 1 and 6 s under condition 2. By what factor is the average rate larger under condition 2?
questions.hint: For the same amount, rate is inversely proportional to time.

questions.subject: chemistry
questions.prompt: What is the oxidation state of sulfur in SO₄²⁻?
questions.hint: Let sulfur be x: x + 4(−2) = −2.

questions.subject: chemistry
questions.prompt: What is the product of complete oxidation of a primary alcohol?
questions.hint: Primary alcohol → aldehyde → carboxylic acid under complete oxidation.

questions.subject: chemistry
questions.prompt: A strong acid has [H⁺] = 2.5×10⁻⁴ mol dm⁻³. Find pH to 3 d.p.
questions.hint: pH=−log₁₀[H⁺].

questions.subject: chemistry
questions.prompt: Which intermolecular force is present between all molecular substances?
questions.hint: Instantaneous dipoles can arise in every electron cloud.

questions.subject: biology
questions.prompt: A cell image measures 40 mm while the actual cell length is 2 μm. Find the magnification.
questions.hint: Convert both lengths to the same unit before using magnification=image size/actual size.

questions.subject: biology
questions.prompt: Which bond joins complementary bases across the two DNA strands?
questions.hint: Base pairs are held together by relatively weak bonds that allow strand separation.

questions.subject: biology
questions.prompt: In a monohybrid cross Aa × Aa, what is the probability of genotype aa?
questions.hint: Use a 2×2 Punnett square.

questions.subject: biology
questions.prompt: Where does the light-independent stage of photosynthesis occur in a chloroplast?
questions.hint: The Calvin cycle enzymes are located in the fluid surrounding the thylakoids.

questions.subject: biology
questions.prompt: Producers contain 18 000 kJ of energy. If 12% is transferred to primary consumers, how much energy reaches them?
questions.hint: Multiply by the transfer efficiency as a decimal.

questions.subject: biology
questions.prompt: Which process directly changes allele frequencies because individuals move between populations?
questions.hint: Movement of alleles between populations accompanies migration.

questions.subject: biology
questions.prompt: Which chamber pumps blood into the systemic circulation?
questions.hint: Systemic circulation begins at the chamber connected to the aorta.

questions.subject: biology
questions.prompt: In a Hardy–Weinberg population, allele frequencies are p=0.4 and q=0.6. Find the expected heterozygote frequency.
questions.hint: Heterozygote frequency = 2pq.

questions.subject: biology
questions.prompt: A cube-shaped cell doubles its side length. By what factor does its surface-area-to-volume ratio change?
questions.hint: For a cube, SA:V is proportional to 1/side length.

questions.subject: biology
questions.prompt: Which enzyme synthesizes RNA from a DNA template during transcription?
questions.hint: The enzyme moves along DNA while joining RNA nucleotides.

questions.subject: biology
questions.prompt: Which molecule is the immediate energy currency used by cells?
questions.hint: It transfers energy through phosphorylation reactions.

questions.subject: biology
questions.prompt: A quadrat survey finds 42 individuals in 7 quadrats of 0.5 m² each. Estimate density in individuals per m².
questions.hint: Density = total individuals / total sampled area.

questions.subject: economics
questions.prompt: Price falls from 10 to 8 while quantity demanded rises from 88 to 105. Using the midpoint method, calculate PED to 2 d.p.
questions.hint: PED = %ΔQd / %ΔP using midpoint percentage changes.

questions.subject: economics
questions.prompt: If the marginal propensity to consume is 0.8, calculate the simple Keynesian multiplier.
questions.hint: Multiplier = 1/(1−MPC).

questions.subject: economics
questions.prompt: Nominal GDP is 574 billion and the GDP deflator is 125. Find real GDP in billions to 1 d.p.
questions.hint: Real GDP = nominal GDP ÷ (deflator/100).

questions.subject: economics
questions.prompt: Exports are $252 bn and imports are $317 bn. Find net exports in $bn.
questions.hint: Net exports = exports − imports.

questions.subject: economics
questions.prompt: Which measure combines health, education and income dimensions?
questions.hint: This composite index is published as a broad development indicator.

questions.subject: economics
questions.prompt: If PED = 0.4, demand is best described as:
questions.hint: Compare the absolute PED value with 1.

questions.subject: economics
questions.prompt: A price index rises from 150 to 169. Calculate the percentage inflation over the period to 2 d.p.
questions.hint: Percentage change = (new−old)/old ×100.

questions.subject: economics
questions.prompt: A currency appreciation, ceteris paribus, tends to make the country’s exports:
questions.hint: Foreign buyers must give up more of their currency for each unit of the appreciated currency.

questions.subject: economics
questions.prompt: A per-unit tax of $4 raises the consumer price from $10 to $14. What tax burden per unit falls on producers?
questions.hint: Producer burden = original producer price − new net price received by producers.

questions.subject: economics
questions.prompt: A Gini coefficient closer to 1 indicates:
questions.hint: The coefficient ranges from perfect equality toward maximum inequality.

questions.subject: economics
questions.prompt: If MPC = 0.75 and autonomous spending rises by $20 bn, what is the simple-model change in equilibrium national income?
questions.hint: Multiplier=1/(1−MPC)=4, then multiply by the spending change.

questions.subject: economics
questions.prompt: If an exchange rate moves from 1.20 to 1.32 units of foreign currency per domestic currency, by what percentage has the domestic currency appreciated?
questions.hint: Percentage change=(1.32−1.20)/1.20×100.

questions.subject: ess

questions.hint: NPP = GPP − respiration.

questions.hint: Efficiency = useful output/input ×100%.

questions.hint: Increase = population × growth rate as a decimal.

questions.subject: ess
questions.prompt: A farm uses 900 m³ of water and 630 m³ reaches crops effectively. Find irrigation efficiency as a percentage.
questions.hint: Efficiency=useful water/input water×100%.

questions.subject: ess
questions.prompt: Which energy source is renewable on human timescales?
questions.hint: Choose the source replenished continuously by natural processes.

questions.subject: ess
questions.prompt: A region has 5900 global hectares of biocapacity. If average ecological footprint is 2.5 gha per person, how many people could be supported at that footprint?
questions.hint: Supported population = total biocapacity ÷ footprint per person.

questions.subject: ess
questions.prompt: If only 10% of trophic-level energy is transferred, how much of 25 000 kJ at producers is expected at secondary consumers?
questions.hint: Apply 10% transfer twice: producer → primary → secondary.

questions.subject: ess
questions.prompt: Which feedback is positive?
options: Ice melts, lowering albedo and increasing absorption
More cloud always reflects all sunlight
questions.hint: A positive feedback amplifies the original change.

questions.subject: ess
questions.prompt: A pollutant concentration is 80 mg L⁻¹ and falls by half every 5 days. What is the concentration after 15 days?
questions.hint: 15 days is three half-lives: multiply by (1/2)³.
